contentText: In Cambodia, French President Emmanuel Macron and King Norodom Sihamoni are expected to inaugurate a newly restored temple at the world-famous Angkor archaeological site on Monday. After 14 years of painstaking work, the Western Mebon, a thousand-year-old monument, has been restored to its former glory. A monumental restoration effort, bringing together Cambodian and French expertise. Alix Ostian, Aruna Popuri and Constantin Simon report.
